question: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'Ret Samadhi'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geetanjali Shree**__

__
 
• **Geetanjali Shree** is the author of the novel 'Ret Samadhi'.
 
• 'Ret Samadhi' is a critically acclaimed novel that has been translated into various languages.
 
• Geetanjali Shree is an Indian author known for her contributions to Hindi literature.
 
• Her works often explore themes of identity, memory, and the human condition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The novel delves into the complexities of familial relationships and the process of self-discovery.
 
• Geetanjali Shree's writing is characterized by its lyrical prose and insightful observations on life.
